paragraphs: I’m a software engineer and a B.Tech graduate of Lovely Professional University (2020 – 2024).

At Stackly I joined as a Software Engineer building Java and Spring Boot APIs for the ONE Enterprise Cloud Platform, then moved up to Lead Software Engineer — leading a 12-member backend team and owning sprint planning, API design and role-based access control across the HRMS, ERP, CRM and Finance modules.

Outside work I build systems end to end: TopCoders, a live coding platform with per-user code sandboxes on AWS Fargate, and SearchForge, a web search engine written from scratch in Java. Before Stackly I interned at Mind Sparc Innovations and ScrollAR4U Technologies.

projects.name: Top Coders — Competitive Programming Platform
projects.summary: A LeetCode-style platform with a browser IDE, hidden-test judging, monthly hackathons and real-time leaderboards.
points: Architected and deployed a coding platform supporting 4 languages (C++, Java, Python, JavaScript) with a browser IDE, hidden-test judging, monthly hackathons, and real-time leaderboards ranked by points and penalty time.
Engineered an on-demand, per-user code sandbox on AWS ECS Fargate with auto-shutdown on idle, logout or tab close, cutting execution compute costs by 92% (~$40 → ~$3/month).
Implemented secure authentication and RBAC: JWT with token-version revocation, bcrypt hashing, email verification, password reset and per-user rate limiting.
Automated AWS infrastructure (IAM, ECR, ECS, ALB, ACM, SSM) and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline running 55 unit, API and end-to-end tests against real MongoDB and runner containers.

projects.name: SearchForge — Web Search Engine from Scratch
projects.summary: A web search engine written from first principles in Java 21 — no Lucene, no Elasticsearch.
points: Built a polite, resumable web crawler: RFC 9309 robots.txt parsing, a per-host politeness frontier, virtual-thread workers, an SSRF guard and SimHash near-duplicate detection.
Designed a compressed positional inverted index built with external merge sort (sorted runs, k-way merge), VByte + d-gap encoding and memory-mapped reads.
Ranked results with BM25F (title, headings and body weighted) plus a PageRank prior; added phrase and boolean queries, top-K autocomplete and BK-tree “Did you mean?” spelling suggestions.
Delivered a Spring Boot API with result caching, per-IP rate limiting and security headers, and a responsive React + TypeScript search UI — with 96–99% line coverage per module enforced by the build.
Led a 12-member backend team building the ONE Enterprise Cloud Platform across HRMS, ERP, CRM and Finance modules.
Owned sprint planning, task estimation and work allocation in Agile cycles to keep releases on schedule.
Drove backend architecture and API design for scalable, maintainable Java and Spring Boot microservices.
Owned platform administration and role-based access control (RBAC), designing roles and permissions that secure data across all modules.
Reviewed pull requests and enforced coding standards, testing practices and clean architecture across the team.
Mentored engineers through technical guidance, pair debugging and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Coordinated with product, frontend and QA teams to define requirements, unblock dependencies and resolve production incidents.
Developed backend features and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot for the HRMS, ERP, CRM and Finance modules of the ONE Enterprise Cloud Platform.
Designed and optimized database schemas and queries to support new platform features.
Wrote unit and integration tests (JUnit, Mockito) to ensure code reliability before release.
Debugged and resolved production issues by analyzing logs, tracing root causes and shipping fixes.
Participated in code reviews, following clean-code principles and team coding standards.
Collaborated with frontend, QA and product teams in Agile sprints to deliver features on schedule.
Designed scalable distributed systems using Java, C++ and Python, improving performance for real-time processing.
Built and optimized RESTful APIs and microservices for large-scale distributed computing environments, enabling real-time predictions at scale.
Solved ambiguous problems with agile methodologies in rapid development cycles, using Git and Docker for version control and deployment.
Developed and integrated AR models into Android and iOS educational apps, aligned with children’s syllabus content.
Led AR feature development in a 7-member engineering team, delivering 50+ interactive AR models across 12 subjects at 60 fps on mid-range devices.
Apps adopted in 200+ schools, boosting student engagement by 85% and improving concept-retention scores by 40% in pilot studies.
